Initialize_DataverseUrl.description: Dataverse environment URL (e.g., https://org.crm.dynamics.com). Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_DataverseUrl.

Initialize_TenantId.description: Entra ID tenant GUID. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TenantId.

Initialize_ClientId.description: App registration client ID for certificate-based Graph auth. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ClientId.

Initialize_CertificateThumbprint.description: Certificate thumbprint for unattended authentication. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_CertificateThumbprint.

Initialize_SubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID containing the Automation account. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_SubscriptionId.

Initialize_ResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group containing the Automation account. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ResourceGroup.

Initialize_AutomationAccount.description: Azure Automation account name. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_AutomationAccount.

Initialize_TeamsGroupId.description: Microsoft Teams team/group ID for alert notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TeamsGroupId.

Initialize_TeamsChannelId.description: Microsoft Teams channel ID for alert notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_TeamsChannelId.

Initialize_ComplianceDistributionList.description: Email distribution list for compliance alert routing. Set via environment variable fsi_CAA_ComplianceDistributionList.

Initialize_ViolationCards.description: Accumulator for adaptive card violation elements built during Apply_to_Each_Violation.

Initialize_DriftCards.description: Accumulator for adaptive card drift elements built during Apply_to_Each_Drift.

Generate_Job_Id.description: Generate a unique GUID for the Azure Automation job.

Create_Automation_Job.description: Start the Azure Automation runbook Start-CAAValidationRunbook to perform CA policy compliance validation.

Wait_Loop.description: Poll Azure Automation job status every 30 seconds until completed, failed, or suspended (2-hour timeout).

Get_Job_Output.description: Retrieve the runbook output JSON from the completed Azure Automation job.

Parse_Results.description: Parse the structured JSON output from Start-CAAValidationRunbook.

Apply_to_Each_Violation.description: Build adaptive card violation elements from parsed Violations array.

Apply_to_Each_Drift.description: Build adaptive card drift elements from parsed DriftItems array.

List_Validation_Records.description: Query Dataverse to verify the runbook wrote the validation history record (audit-first pattern).

Create_Fallback_Record.description: Fallback: create validation history record if the runbook crashed before writing to Dataverse.

Verify_Dataverse_Record.description: Verify the runbook wrote an immutable validation history record to Dataverse. Create a fallback record if missing.

Compose_Adaptive_Card.description: Compose the adaptive card with all severity, zone, violation, and drift data from parsed results.

Post_Teams_Alert.description: Post severity-classified adaptive card alert to the designated Teams channel.

Check_Job_Status.description: Branch based on Azure Automation job status: Completed → parse results and route alerts; Failed/Suspended → send CRITICAL failure notification.

Scope_Try.description: Main execution scope: run Azure Automation compliance job, parse results, verify Dataverse record, and route alerts.

properties.description: Daily CA policy compliance validation via Azure Automation with Dataverse audit trail and severity-classified Teams/email alerts. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511/3110, SEC 17a-3/4, SOX 302/404. Part of the FSI Agent Governance — Conditional Access Automation solution.
